versions.description: New Player Check: an anti-cheat check for players who join this server for the first time. It catches cheated or transferred characters: a level above your limit, forbidden items, too many of an item, or a too-full inventory. By default it only alerts admins (in-game PM to players with the alerts permission, plus an optional Discord channel). Per rule you can also kick, ban or give a role such as Flagged. Admins run npcheck <player> to check someone now and npclear <player> to mark them reviewed. Level is checked only when the game reports it; inventory needs a connector that reports inventories.

commands.name: npcheck
commands.description: Run the new player check on a player now
commands.helpText: Usage: npcheck <player>. Shows the player's level and inventory findings. It does not kick, ban or alert others.

commands.name: npclear
commands.description: Mark a player as reviewed by the new player check
commands.helpText: Usage: npclear <player>. The player is no longer checked automatically and loses the flag role.

arguments.name: player
arguments.helpText: The player to mark as reviewed

hooks.name: check-on-join
hooks.description: Checks a player on their first join on this server (and every join during the watch window).

cronJobs.name: recheck-pending
cronJobs.description: Retries the check for new players whose inventory was not known yet when they joined.

functions.name: npcheck-core

permissions.description: Online players with this permission get a PM when a new player fails the check.
Allows npcheck (check a player now) and npclear (mark a player reviewed).
Players with this permission are never checked automatically.
